links.outcome: LLM accuracy on pediatric critical care calculation questions versus other categories
links.effect: LLMs excelled in ethics but struggled with calculations. Overall accuracy was 78% for Llama-3.3-70B and 75% for Phi-4; calculation-category figures are not given in the abstract.
links.quote: The LLMs excelled in ethics but struggled with calculations.

unlisted_practices: Comparing small locally-deployable open-source LLMs against larger models on board-style questions

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and clinical reasoning of multiple open-source LLMs on pediatric critical care multiple-choice exam questions compared to fellows, without testing a deployment safeguard or practice.
